test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'contamination'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Contamination** means the process of making something dirty or poisonous or the state of containing unwanted or dangerous substances.

 ** • Example- **Always keep food covered to prevent contamination by flies.

 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is 'contamination'.

**The complete sentence** is- *Pollution is the contamination __of the environment and the biggest problem across the globe.*​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mixture** means a substance that is made by mixing other substances together.
 
• **Impure** means not pure or clean; consisting of more than one substance mixed together.
 
• **Adulteration** means the action of making something poorer in quality by the addition of another substance.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.
